label: 03 — How we work
heading: From first contact to
sub: Every engagement follows the same four steps. You always know which one you are in, what comes next, and what it costs.

steps.title: Assess
steps.desc: A free conversation about your needs, goals, constraints and working expectations helps both sides decide whether to work together, without obligation.

steps.title: Agree
steps.desc: Choose hourly support with reserved capacity or fixed-price project delivery. Any technical investigation has its scope, deliverables, time limit and price agreed before it starts; delivery terms are then agreed in a Statement of Work.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.desc: Work runs in short cycles with written progress reports; architecture is documented as it is decided, and nothing is done until you sign off.

steps.title: Support
steps.desc: After go-live, committed hours cover escalation support and further work, at a rate set by how long you commit.
